about_the_game:
Crashlands 2 is an incredible labor of handcrafted love, from the tiniest Frug to the sluggiest Bun. This digital artbook gives you a glimpse into the messy, sprawling journey of how we created the game’s distinctive visual style, including some of the skills, tech, and tricks we developed along the way. Check out never-before-seen early sketches, concept art, and storyboards, and learn about the process involved in turning a rough idea into a living part of the world of Crashlands 2.

Included:

-   All 57 of Flux's body parts 😱

-   Broken-apart views of terrain

-   Animation breakdowns for creatures

-   Cutscene drafts and processes

-   And some digital art files you can use to create your own Woanopian wildlife!

After Installation

After purchasing and installing the Making of Crashlands 2 – Artbook DLC, you’ll find the PDF file titled Making of Crashlands 2 – Artbook.pdf in the main installation directory of Crashlands 2 under the "Artbook" folder.

For example, on Windows, this is typically:
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Crashlands 2

If you’re not sure where Crashlands 2 is installed, here’s how to locate it:

  • Open your Steam Library and right-click on Crashlands 2.

  • Select Properties…

  • Go to the Installed Files tab.

  • Click Browse… to open the game’s install folder.
